records.description: Princes Street Gardens is Edinburgh's landmark green space below the Castle, with east and west sections, the Ross Bandstand and several toilets. Cruising guides have mentioned facilities within the gardens, but the original Squirt references seem to describe different toilets, not one confirmed meeting point. Recent reply dates were displayed for the Ross Bandstand and West WC listings in October–November 2026, but their actual messages could not be read; a reply date alone is not an encounter. The city publishes clear gate times, currently opening at 07:00 and closing at 18:00 from late October through December, with gates beginning to shut earlier. It would be misleading to recommend night cruising here. Without identifying which restroom is meant and confirming actual recent activity, this remains a historic directory lead rather than a usable listing.
blockers: Council's seasonal evening closure limits access
records.address: Princes Street Gardens, Princes Street, Edinburgh
records.tags: Park, Historic City Centre, Restrooms, Unverified
records.opening_notes: Official 26 Oct–31 Dec: 07:00–18:00, west gates close from 17:00, east from 17:15.

records.description: London Road Gardens is the wooded park on the east side of Calton Hill in Edinburgh. An old cruising directory refers to paths beyond the Cottage after midnight, but it contains no dated visitors' comments and doesn't establish whether those paths are accessible at that time. The Woodland Trust records that the gardens were formerly known as Royal Terrace Gardens, making this likely to overlap with another candidate already in the research queue. A restaurant now occupies the former gardener's cottage, another reason not to treat a historic landmark description as current cruising guidance. This is a public landscape with ordinary walkers and neighbourhood visitors. Neither reliable recent activity, exact gathering area, crowd nor legal late-night entry is established. It needs duplicate reconciliation and genuine contemporary visitor evidence.
blockers: Likely duplicate/overlap of Royal Terrace Gardens #540
records.address: London Road Gardens, London Road, Edinburgh
records.tags: Wooded Park, Heritage, Historical Reports, Potential Duplicate
records.opening_notes: No verified late-night opening. An old directory suggested after midnight only.

records.description: Noord Aa on the edge of Zoetermeer has a recognised gay men's meeting area beside the wider lakeside naturist recreation zone. Local descriptions distinguish this HOP section from the neighbouring family beach, so follow the signs rather than assuming the whole shoreline is a gay space. Visitors writing in the independent beach guestbook on 12 and 31 July 2026 described going to the gay section, giving the place recent firsthand attention even though they did not report sexual encounters. It makes more sense as a fair-weather outdoor destination than a guaranteed busy night spot, and there is no reliably documented numerical age range or fixed peak hour. The naturist beach's rules explicitly discourage sexual behaviour in shared public areas. Respect other visitors and their privacy, observe any swimming-water warnings, and leave the family section separate.
records.tags: Lakeside, Naturist, Gay Meeting Area, Outdoor, Summer
records.opening_notes: Open recreation area; expect weather-dependent daytime visits. Respect separate signed areas and published swimming advice.
caveats: Designated gay meeting section does not mean permission for public sex

records.description: Südkreuz station in southern Berlin has a longstanding reputation for discreet meetings around its paid public toilets. The old gay-szene listing points towards the west entrance by Burger King, but Deutsche Bahn lists more than one rail & fresh WC and recent commenters disagree about which facility is involved. The station itself is easy to reach on S-Bahn and regional trains, and the original guide quoted a one-euro entry charge, which may have changed. More importantly, several January–February 2026 visitors described the toilets being back in operation after renovation and reported encounters; an October question shows people still looking for the right side but doesn't establish renewed activity. There's no defensible age profile or guaranteed peak time. These are shared, staffed transport facilities, so respect other passengers, privacy and the operator's rules.
records.address: Bahnhof Berlin Südkreuz, west-entrance side, Berlin
records.tags: Railway Station, Public Restroom, Paid Access, Recent Cruising Reports
records.opening_notes: DB rail & fresh toilets may operate 24 hours; individual opening, security and price can change. The older €1 price is not confirmed.
caveats: Two station WCs; comments may not consistently mean the same one

records.description: Fennpfuhl Park in Berlin-Lichtenberg has a lake, lawns and an unusual wind sculpture that older gay guides use as a landmark. Those guides suggest the benches and paths near the sculpture, mainly from about 20:00 into the night. The trouble is the recent evidence: a March 2026 forum user only asked whether anything still happened there, and several 2024 visitors described few or no contacts. One older reviewer also complained about harassment, which is worth remembering but shouldn't be presented as a verified current threat. This is an ordinary, open city park with cyclists, local residents and other visitors. There's no recent firsthand account demonstrating that the claimed cruising scene remains active, or any trustworthy present-day crowd profile, so the old suggested hours aren't enough to recommend it.
